text:
carla-sales: Heads-up — Zenith had a POC demo meltdown, their frontend logged JSON.parse errors and the transcript stopped mid-sentence.
matt-zenith: during the live walkthrough the transcript showed: 
```
event: message
data: {\"id\":\"req-77\",\"chunk\":\"Order confirmation: Your ord\"
data: {\"id\":\"req-77\",\"chunk\":\"er #123 arrived\"}

# then socket closed and app choked on parse
```
carla-sales: timeline: demo started 11:05, first partial at 11:06, disconnect 11:07; attendee Qs paused the demo.
omar-eng: that pattern looks like truncated SSE events (missing boundary) — likely the server closed mid-write. Can you share gateway logs or raw dump?
matt-zenith: sent raw body via DM. Headers show `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` and `Connection: keep-alive`.
yuna-sre: checking infra: worker-21 on dedicated pool had `oom-kill` at 11:03 and multiple `write` errors at 11:06: `write() returned -1, errno 104`. Also saw a cron that spikes memory at :02.
ohana-ml: (hana-ml): generator trace shows it hit a memory threshold and the subprocess exited before finishing JSON emit. If the runtime exits without emitting a terminal SSE event, clients get partial JSON.
ben-sdk: client-side note — our browser demo parser requires SSE events to be delimited by a blank line. If connection closes mid-event the parse will throw "Unexpected end of JSON input". Short-term workaround: buffer incoming data until you see `\n\n`, and on parse error wait up to 500ms for more bytes before failing. I'll paste a 3-line snippet.
carla-sales: can we give the customer a one-liner to keep the demo going?
ben-sdk: try this pattern: collect chunks into `buf` and only call `JSON.parse(buf)` when `buf.endsWith('\n\n')` or after retry on parse error. I'll DM the snippet to sales.
yuna-sre: infra fix — increase worker memory headroom, disable the noisy cron, and redeploy a pinned runtime without the experimental allocator. Starting canary.
deploy-bot: deploy initiated: infra/dedicated-worker-memory-bump @1898001308. Canary nodes=2.
omar-eng: server hardening: add a write flush that guarantees each SSE event ends with `\n\n` and, on generator crash, emit a final SSE `{\"error\":\"generator-exit\"}` so clients get a clean terminal event. Also add a counter `sse_truncated_events_total`.
ohana-ml: adding generation-side budget guard so generator aborts gracefully before OOM and writes a final error message.
matt-zenith: applying the client buffer workaround now to proceed with the rest of the demo — thanks. ETA on canary?
yuna-sre: canary healthy at 11:13, no write errors seen in 6 test streams. Full rollout in ~9 minutes.
carla-sales: telling Zenith to pause for 15min and then replay. Thanks team for the quick triage.
matt-zenith: replayed after rollback and memory bump; stream completed fully, no parse errors. Demo resumed. Great response. :tada:
omar-eng: follow-ups: (1) server-side SSE boundary guard, (2) metric+alert for `sse_truncated_events_total`, (3) increase pool memory headroom and disable cron, (4) SDK demo buffering snippet and sales playbook note.
ben-sdk: PR with snippet and short explanation opened, linking to demo templates.
carla-sales: closing thread once Zenith signs off on POC stability. Thanks everyone :heart:
